dialog.agent:
I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.

The picker marks Veo 3 as paid and quotes **80 credits**, but your connected free-tier account can’t run paid models. I won’t substitute another model, since you requested **Veo 3 only**.

To proceed, you’d need an account eligible for Veo 3. I’d then ask for your explicit approval of the final settings and cost before generating the widescreen neon-rain clip with rain sounds.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

dialog.agent:
Veo 3 is blocked on your free plan, so trying it won’t produce a clip.

Would you approve switching to **LTX 2.5 at 480p** for a **5-second widescreen neon-rain clip with rain sounds**? That changes your “Veo 3 only” requirement and uses generation credits, so I’ll wait for your confirmation.
dialog.user: No, please don’t switch models—I still want Veo 3 only, so leave it ungenerated if my free plan can’t run it. I haven’t approved spending any credits. The picker quoted 80 credits for Veo 3, which is why I wanted to be asked before anything was spent.

turns.agent: Understood—**Veo 3 only, with no model substitution**. Your free plan can’t run it, so I’ve left the clip ungenerated. No generation was started and no credits were spent.
